name: How long does a typical bathroom vanity installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom vanity installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom vanity installation can usually be completed in one to two days, depending on the project's scope. This timeframe includes removing the old vanity, preparing the area, installing the new unit, connecting plumbing, and ensuring all fixtures are functional. More complex projects, such as those requiring significant changes to plumbing lines, new flooring, or electrical work, may extend the timeline. Maine Results, Inc. provides a project schedule upfront, detailing the steps and estimated duration for your specific installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most vanity installations take one to two days, but complex projects with plumbing or electrical changes may take longer.
